title: US Plans Significant Force Reductions for NATO Europe Deployments
detail: The United States is planning significant force reductions for its NATO deployments in Europe, according to reports, signaling a continued shift in American security commitments to the alliance. The planned drawdown underscores the broader 'NATO 3.0' transition in which Washington is pressing European members to bear a greater share of collective defense, ahead of the July 7–8 Ankara Leaders' Summit.
